title: Old Skateboard into Industrial Hanging Bookshelf
description: Turned my snapped 7-ply maple skateboard deck into a suspended corner bookshelf with heavy duty hemp rope and brass ferrules.
precautions: Wear eye goggles when drilling through maple ply layers to prevent flying splinters.
Anchor ceiling hooks firmly into wooden joists or with heavy wall anchors.

steps.title: Strip trucks & grip tape
steps.instructions: Warm grip tape with hair dryer to peel off cleanly. Remove old hardware and sand down the rough break line.

steps.title: Drill 4 corner guide holes
steps.instructions: Enlarge existing truck mounting holes to 12mm diameter to fit thick hemp suspension cord.

steps.title: Hang & level
steps.instructions: Thread rope, tie tight figure-eight stopper knots underneath, and hang from ceiling brackets.

comments.author: Leo Vance
comments.text: The natural maple grain looks incredible against the raw rope!

comments.author: Zara Chen
comments.text: Did you apply polyurethane before or after tying knots?

title: Stained Glass Style Sun-catcher from Waste Plastic Bottles
description: Cut colored beverage bottles into floral petals, lightly shrunk them with a heat tool, and bound them into a stained-glass style sun catcher.
precautions: Do not overheat plastic; work in a ventilated room or outdoors.
Trim sharp edges with fine sanding sponge.

steps.title: Trace petal templates
steps.instructions: Cut flat sheets from bottle bodies, draw organic teardrop petals, and cut out with sharp scissors.

steps.title: Shape with heat and wire together
steps.instructions: Pass rapidly 4 inches above candle flame to curl edges naturally, punch holes, and link with copper rings.

comments.author: Marcus Brody
comments.text: The way sunlight refracts through these green PET bottles is pure magic!

title: Geometric Wall Art from Delivery Box Cardboard
description: Constructed a 3D isometric wall sculpture using layered fluting from 4 corrugated delivery boxes.
precautions: Score cardboard lightly without cutting all the way through for clean geometric folds.

steps.title: Cut hexagonal modules
steps.instructions: Cut 24 equilateral triangles and hexagons of varying heights to generate 3D shadow relief.

steps.title: Mount on backing board and paint
steps.instructions: Adhere tightly with wood glue, then spray or brush in warm terracotta and sage tones.

comments.author: Elena Rostova
comments.text: Stunning brutalist texture! Trying this this weekend.
